title: Queue host-CPU fallback rejects the boolean describe argument
body: A queued full Debug VIXEN build failed after 566/727 actions when the live wrapper called box-queue-core hostcpu with --describe true; the pinned core parser accepts --describe as a flag and rejected the following true (exit 70). Recovery reran the unchanged queued build with UT_QUEUE_HOST_CPU_WSL=0, which used the Linux /proc/stat fallback and completed. Consolidate the wrapper/core contract so hostcpu describe uses the accepted flag form or fails during queue preflight. Tier luna: the fix spans the shell/core argument contract and needs a regression check; effort S.
